title: Slicing a current and its boundary: combined slice mass bound (V4(ii), steps 5, 7 and 9)
statement: Assume (SL), the exact frozen statement of the parent's dependency cmc_slice_mass_bounds: for all P, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), admissible representations (μ, ξ) of T and (μ', ξ') of ∂T in U (Borel measures finite on compact subsets of U; a.e. strongly measurable fields of (k+1)- resp. k-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for a.e. x; T(ω) = ∫ ξ(ω) dμ and ∂T(η) = ∫ ξ'(η) dμ' for all test forms in U) and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω) dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η) dμ', ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η misses {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L · liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹ μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for open W, and ∫_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for open W. Let P, d ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, X ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U), (μ, ξ) an admissible representation of X and (μ', ξ') an admissible representation of ∂X in U (as above), and f : ℝ^P → ℝ L-Lipschitz (L ∈ ℝ≥0). Then there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) and B_t ∈ 𝒟_d(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω) dμ and B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η) dμ' for all t ∈ ℝ and all test forms ω, η in U, such that for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P and every t ∈ ℝ, with Z_t := ∂A_t − B_t, M_W(Z_t) + boundaryMassOn(Z_t, W) ≤ L · liminf_{h→0, h>0} ofReal(h⁻¹) · (μ + μ')(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) in [0, ∞], where boundaryMassOn(Z_t, W) = M_W(∂Z_t) if d ≥ 1 and = 0 if d = 0.

B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen W → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ((A t).boundary -
